main.remarks: Immutable verification input model supplied to access-key signature processors.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Create an empty access-key signature validation context.

property.name: AccessKeyRealmID
property.summary: Current access-key realm identifier for the verification operation.

property.name: Logger
property.summary: Optional logger available to the configured signature processor for diagnostics.

property.name: ManifestHash
property.summary: Current manifest hash associated with the validation operation.

property.name: Signature
property.summary: Parsed outer signature metadata read from the access-key envelope.

property.name: SignatureBytes
property.summary: Raw signature bytes from the access-key envelope.

property.name: SignedRegion
property.summary: Canonical signed-region bytes from the access-key envelope.

property.name: ToolSchemaID
property.summary: Current tool schema identifier for the verification operation.
